ATTRACT VISITORS. UNDERSTAND THE IMPACT.

More than visitor numbers.

For tourism boards, destination managers and local government planners. The challenge: attract visitors and visitor spending while managing seasonal pressure on services and residents. Compare national evidence to decide what to promote, when to promote it, and which local information is still needed.

2024Destination outlookTourism baseline · 16 countries
Transport: 2023 · Energy: Dec 2025
Why compare countries?

Comparing visitor numbers, seasonal demand and spending helps tourism boards understand different markets and identify what to research before planning promotion. The focus country is the country you want to explore; the reference country is the country you compare it with. For travel agencies, these national figures provide background—not package prices, customer demand or expected profit. Choosing trips also requires destination-level hotel prices, flight availability and customer preferences.

National context, local decisions

16 selected countries with energy and tourism data. National totals cannot reveal neighbourhood crowding.
